description: This file defines the ReviewListAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It provides an API endpoint to retrieve a list of performance reviews, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination. The class utilizes traits for authentication and service operations, and implements methods for validation and data retrieval following RESTful principles.
